name: Dublin Core
description: The 15 core elements of Dublin Core (ISO 15836). Suitable for general resource description.

fields.name: dc_title
fields.label: Title
fields.placeholder: A name given to the resource
fields.help_text: DC: title — a name given to the resource

fields.name: dc_creator
fields.label: Creator
fields.placeholder: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource
fields.help_text: DC: creator — use Agents tab for structured creator links

fields.name: dc_subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.help_text: DC: subject — topic, keywords, or classification codes

fields.name: dc_description
fields.label: Description
fields.help_text: DC: description — may include abstract, table of contents, or free-text account

fields.name: dc_publisher
fields.label: Publisher
fields.placeholder: An entity responsible for making the resource available

fields.name: dc_contributor
fields.label: Contributor
fields.placeholder: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource

fields.name: dc_date
fields.label: Date
fields.help_text: DC: date — a point or period of time associated with the resource lifecycle

fields.name: dc_format
fields.label: Format
fields.help_text: DC: format — file format, physical medium, or dimensions

fields.name: dc_identifier
fields.label: Identifier
fields.placeholder: An unambiguous reference to the resource
fields.help_text: DC: identifier — URI, ISBN, DOI etc.

fields.name: dc_source
fields.label: Source
fields.placeholder: A related resource from which the described resource is derived

fields.name: dc_language
fields.label: Language
fields.help_text: DC: language — ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language tag

fields.name: dc_relation
fields.label: Relation
fields.help_text: DC: relation — use Relations tab for structured links

fields.name: dc_coverage
fields.label: Coverage
fields.help_text: DC: coverage — jurisdiction, place name, period, or coordinates

fields.name: dc_rights
fields.label: Rights
fields.placeholder: Information about rights held in or over the resource
fields.help_text: DC: rights — rights statement, license URI, or copyright notice
